namedWrittenCases: audit inputs: original pre-cutoff value matches while later vintages stay diagnostic
audit inputs: later-value counterexample is a supported mismatch without future selection
audit inputs: latest strictly prior observation supersedes an older supplied value
audit inputs: before-earliest future-only observation yields null verdict and selection
audit inputs: same-day date-only filing makes an earlier selected observation diagnostic
audit inputs: UTC used_on cannot establish intraday availability of a date-only filing
audit inputs: conflicting latest-date accessions stay ambiguous in either source order
audit inputs: equal values on distinct latest accessions do not invent a selected accession
audit inputs: exact duplicates remain visible and a unique later prior filing resolves old ties
audit inputs: all six outcomes retain the full selected-N denominator
audit inputs: absent company taxonomy concept and empty reference never zero-fill
audit inputs: exact units and opaque per-share conventions prohibit implicit conversion
audit inputs: quarter YTD instant and concept aliases stay separate
audit inputs: unsupported taxonomies and forms cannot establish periodic availability
audit inputs: negative losses explicit zero fractions and safe edge values compare exactly
audit inputs: nonnumeric null boolean string and nonfinite values refuse
audit inputs: raw decimal rounding underflow and numeric-token overflow refuse
audit inputs: malformed calendars non-UTC cutoffs and contradictory periods refuse
audit inputs: declared capture chronology completeness and unknown reasons stay explicit
audit inputs: CIK accession fiscal metadata and closed schemas validate without coercion
audit inputs: duplicate escaped JSON keys malformed syntax and trailing data refuse
audit inputs: malformed UTF8 unpaired surrogates and oversized decoded strings refuse
audit inputs: prototype-looking concept keys remain owned and cannot supply inherited facts
audit inputs: raw reference tampering at every byte defeats the separately supplied SHA
audit inputs: expected hash refuses arrays objects boxed strings and uppercase without coercion
audit inputs: byte APIs reject proxies subclasses shared storage and object getters
audit inputs: native byte-slot copying ignores caller properties and respects view offsets
audit inputs: byte inputs remain unchanged and all returned descendants are frozen
audit inputs: independent raw usage settings and whole-source declarations bind exact bytes
audit inputs: deterministic public JSON roundtrip preserves the shared canonical content hash
audit inputs: each explicit raw byte ceiling accepts its boundary and refuses one extra byte
audit inputs: usage and company ceilings retain every row at the accepted boundary
audit inputs: source-row and expanded-vintage ceilings refuse aggregate overflow without truncation
audit inputs: parser depth node and lexical bounds refuse before unsupported structure processing
audit inputs: absent calibration rights universe and formal restatement claims stay null
audit inputs: executable documented import example is offline and produces the literal outcome
